item.title: DOJ, Ohio File Antitrust Suit Against OhioHealth Over Payer Contracts
item.description: The Department of Justice and the state of Ohio filed an antitrust lawsuit against OhioHealth this week, alleging the health system used “all-or-nothing” contracts that force insurers to include all of its hospitals and physicians.
